scope: RP2040 Cortex-M0+ binary64 addition and subtraction fast paths; no floating ABI or IEEE semantics change.

implementation.reason_for_previous_cost: Normal arithmetic decoded exponents in both the guard and signed unpacking, and used signed cancellation/normalization for equal-sign sums.
changes: Reuse the decoded sign/exponent in both normal paths.
For equal signs, add unsigned significands and retain the packed exponent/sign; at most one normalization bit is needed.
Keep full guard/sticky information and exact nearest-even midpoint rounding, including both alignment directions and gaps of 32..53 bits.
Remove repeated output range checks in the mixed-sign path: normal inputs with maximum biased exponent 55..2045 guarantee a normal or zero result.
Keep zero/subnormal/NaN/infinity/extreme-exponent handling in the existing independent IEEE fallback.
implementation.license: Existing BSD-3-Clause SDK foundation with independent project changes. Qfplib is an external, separate comparison APP.

armv6m_rp2040.abi: Cortex-M0, soft EABI registers, R4-R11/SP preserved; writes stack and SIO divider only
armv6m_rp2040.timing_note: Instruction counts are emulator diagnostics, not measured RP2040 cycles.

production_elf_math.abi: Cortex-M0, soft EABI registers, R4-R11/SP preserved; writes stack and SIO divider only
production_elf_math.timing_note: Instruction counts are emulator diagnostics, not measured RP2040 cycles.

new_addition_cases.coverage: All sign combinations, both argument orders, exponent guards, alignment gaps 0/1/2/31/32/33/52/53/54/55/60/64, nearest-even ties and significand carries.

physical_math.location: Local compact_math and owned arithmetic execute in SRAM; no resident math imports.

tests.link_map_gate: PASS: no extracted libgcc archive members

firmware.resident_hardware_runtime_during_probes: GCC/compiler-runtime; local comparison arithmetic and math execute from SRAM.

limits: Reported latencies apply to the published fixed pairs and six deterministic streams, not every operand distribution.
OWN, BASE and QFP run from SRAM; GCC is a resident Flash control.
The mixed_sign_close stream remains slower than Qfplib; equal-sign addition and the aggregate corpora have lower latency.
No new binary32 performance claim is made.
The replacement firmware is built and its ELF is tested; hardware validation uses temporary local APPs and preserves the calculator state.
